flagship.title: Laurel, with room for a picnic
flagship.standfirst: A short woodland loop and a leisurely picnic at Morrow Mountain: a deliberately gentle Uwharrie day, rather than a summit hike.
flagship.why_this_week: Tuesday’s farm circuit stays closer to the Sandhills; this western option makes a longer day of a much shorter walk. Follow the red-hexagon Laurel loop opposite the park office and museum, then leave time for a picnic in an open designated area. The official 0.7 mile is the complete loop, not the longer Morrow Mountain Trail. It is a fairly long drive for a small walk, so choose this for an unhurried Uwharrie visit rather than a mileage goal. Rupert stays outside the museum. Hiking trails are marked open; the park now asks walkers to report downed trees, so an open status is not a promise of obstacle-free footing. This morning’s NWS forecast is mostly cloudy around 70F for both weekend days; recheck it before leaving.

access.name: Park office and museum parking, 49104 Morrow Mountain Road, Albemarle
access.parking: Use designated parking at the park office/museum, then the signed Laurel Trail opposite this area on the official map. Do not park on road shoulders. Free day use. October gates 7 a.m.–9 p.m., November 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; day-use areas close one hour before the gate. Finish in daylight.

panels.label: The shorter woodland choice
panels.text: The official Laurel Trail is 0.7 mile, easy, and marked with red hexagons. Start at the park-office/museum area shown on the official map; this is not the 2.6-mile Morrow Mountain Trail.

panels.label: Keep the day modest
panels.text: Allow time for Rupert’s pauses and a picnic if conditions permit. Pets cannot enter the museum. Skip the outing for unsafe weather or footing rather than adding a harder trail.

pivot.note: Postpone. Another exposed trail or a picnic is not a storm alternative; recheck official status and NWS before leaving.

conditions.trail_note: Stay on the red-hexagon Laurel loop. Wet leaves, roots and downed branches may obstruct the path; turn back rather than climbing around an unsafe obstacle. Finish in daylight, and keep pets out of buildings.

practical.best_window: Saturday or Sunday morning in full daylight, after checking the latest forecast and trail status. Sunday returns to standard time; daylight ends earlier by the clock. Day-use areas close one hour before the gate.
practical.fees: Free ordinary day use; facility reservations, boat rentals and swim passes are separate.
